Analyzing Solutions

A comprehensive guide to analyzing C# solutions with RoselineMCP.

Overview

The analyzeSolution tool provides powerful capabilities for analyzing entire C# solutions, identifying code issues, and generating actionable insights.

Basic Analysis

Simple Solution Analysis

{
  "tool": "analyzeSolution",
  "parameters": {
    "pathOrGit": "/path/to/YourSolution.sln"
  }
}

Directory-Based Analysis

If you have a directory with a single solution:

{
  "tool": "analyzeSolution",
  "parameters": {
    "pathOrGit": "/path/to/solution/directory"
  }
}

Filtering Options

By Severity

Control which diagnostic levels to include:

{
  "tool": "analyzeSolution",
  "parameters": {
    "pathOrGit": "/path/to/solution.sln",
    "severity": "warning"  // Options: error, warning, info, hidden
  }
}

Severity Hierarchy:

  • error: Only compilation errors
  • warning: Errors and warnings
  • info: Errors, warnings, and suggestions
  • hidden: All diagnostics including hidden ones

By Project Names

Include Specific Projects

{
  "tool": "analyzeSolution",
  "parameters": {
    "pathOrGit": "/path/to/solution.sln",
    "include": "Core|Domain|Services"  // Regex pattern
  }
}

Exclude Projects

{
  "tool": "analyzeSolution",
  "parameters": {
    "pathOrGit": "/path/to/solution.sln",
    "exclude": "Test|Mock|Stub"  // Regex pattern
  }
}

Limiting Results

{
  "tool": "analyzeSolution",
  "parameters": {
    "pathOrGit": "/path/to/solution.sln",
    "maxDiagnostics": 100  // Default: 100
  }
}

Advanced Scenarios

Production Code Analysis

Focus on production code with strict severity:

{
  "tool": "analyzeSolution",
  "parameters": {
    "pathOrGit": "/path/to/solution.sln",
    "exclude": "Test|Benchmark|Sample",
    "severity": "warning",
    "maxDiagnostics": 200
  }
}

Critical Issues Only

Find blocking issues:

{
  "tool": "analyzeSolution",
  "parameters": {
    "pathOrGit": "/path/to/solution.sln",
    "severity": "error",
    "maxDiagnostics": 50
  }
}

Comprehensive Analysis

Full analysis including all severities:

{
  "tool": "analyzeSolution",
  "parameters": {
    "pathOrGit": "/path/to/solution.sln",
    "severity": "hidden",
    "maxDiagnostics": 500
  }
}

Understanding Results

Response Structure

{
  "solution": "YourSolution.sln",
  "projects": 12,
  "diagnosticSummary": {
    "error": 2,
    "warning": 145,
    "info": 89,
    "hidden": 12
  },
  "topDiagnostics": [
    {
      "project": "YourApp.Core",
      "file": "Services/UserService.cs",
      "line": 42,
      "column": 15,
      "id": "CS0168",
      "severity": "warning",
      "message": "The variable 'ex' is declared but never used"
    }
  ]
}

Key Metrics

  • projects: Total number of projects analyzed
  • diagnosticSummary: Breakdown by severity
  • topDiagnostics: Most important issues (sorted by severity and location)

Common Diagnostic IDs

Compiler Warnings (CS*)

ID Description Severity
CS0168 Variable declared but never used Warning
CS0219 Variable assigned but never used Warning
CS0414 Field assigned but never used Warning
CS0649 Field never assigned Warning
CS1591 Missing XML documentation Warning
CS8600 Possible null reference Warning
CS8618 Non-nullable property not initialized Warning

IDE Suggestions (IDE*)

ID Description Severity
IDE0001 Simplify name Info
IDE0005 Remove unnecessary imports Info
IDE0017 Use object initializers Info
IDE0031 Use null propagation Info
IDE0051 Remove unused private member Info
IDE0059 Remove unnecessary value assignment Info
IDE0060 Remove unused parameter Info

Roslynator (RCS*)

ID Description Severity
RCS1001 Add braces Info
RCS1018 Add accessibility modifiers Warning
RCS1036 Remove redundant empty line Info
RCS1089 Use postfix increment/decrement Info
RCS1213 Remove unused member declaration Warning

StyleCop (SA*)

ID Description Severity
SA1000 Spacing around keywords Warning
SA1101 Prefix local calls with 'this' Warning
SA1200 Using directives placement Warning
SA1309 Field names must not start with underscore Warning
SA1600 Elements should be documented Warning

Workflow Examples

1. Progressive Analysis

Start broad, then narrow down:

# Step 1: Get overview
analyzeSolution --path /src/solution.sln

# Step 2: Focus on errors
analyzeSolution --path /src/solution.sln --severity error

# Step 3: Check specific projects
analyzeSolution --path /src/solution.sln --include "Core"

# Step 4: Deep dive into warnings
analyzeSolution --path /src/solution.sln --severity warning --max 200

2. CI/CD Pipeline Analysis

# GitHub Actions example
- name: Analyze Code Quality
  run: |
    RESULT=$(analyzeSolution --path ${{ github.workspace }}/Solution.sln \
      --exclude "Test" \
      --severity error)
    
    if [[ $RESULT == *"\"error\": 0"* ]]; then
      echo "✅ No errors found"
    else
      echo "❌ Errors detected"
      exit 1
    fi

3. Technical Debt Assessment

# Comprehensive analysis for technical debt
analyzeSolution \
  --path /src/LegacyApp.sln \
  --severity hidden \
  --maxDiagnostics 1000 \
  > tech-debt-report.json

# Process results
cat tech-debt-report.json | jq '.diagnosticSummary'

Performance Optimization

Large Solutions

For solutions with many projects:

  1. Filter by project patterns to reduce scope
  2. Use severity filters to focus on important issues
  3. Limit diagnostics to prevent overwhelming output
  4. Process in batches by analyzing project groups

Memory Considerations

  • Each project loads into memory during analysis
  • Large solutions may require increased memory
  • Consider analyzing projects individually for very large solutions

Troubleshooting

No Diagnostics Found

Causes:

  • No analyzers installed in projects
  • Build errors preventing analysis
  • All issues filtered out

Solutions:

<!-- Add to .csproj files -->
<PackageReference Include="Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers" Version="8.0.0" />
<PackageReference Include="Roslynator.Analyzers" Version="4.0.0" />

Timeout Issues

For large solutions:

{
  "pathOrGit": "/path/to/large-solution.sln",
  "include": "Priority",  // Analyze priority projects first
  "maxDiagnostics": 50    // Limit initial results
}

Missing Projects

Ensure all projects are properly referenced:

# Verify solution file
dotnet sln list

Best Practices

  1. Start with High Severity: Focus on errors first
  2. Use Project Filters: Exclude test/sample projects for production analysis
  3. Regular Analysis: Run regularly to catch issues early
  4. Track Metrics: Monitor diagnostic counts over time
  5. Combine with Fixes: Use analysis to identify fixable issues

Integration Examples

With Claude Desktop

"Analyze my solution at /src/MyApp.sln focusing on the Core projects"
"Show me all errors in the production code"
"What are the top 10 warnings in my solution?"

Shell Script

#!/bin/bash
# analyze-quality.sh

SOLUTION_PATH="$1"
SEVERITY="${2:-warning}"

echo "Analyzing $SOLUTION_PATH..."
RESULT=$(analyzeSolution \
  --path "$SOLUTION_PATH" \
  --severity "$SEVERITY" \
  --exclude "Test")

ERROR_COUNT=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq '.diagnosticSummary.error')
WARNING_COUNT=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq '.diagnosticSummary.warning')

echo "Found $ERROR_COUNT errors and $WARNING_COUNT warnings"
